case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You pointed to alloy and material costs in your offer, so we looked at exactly those lines, and Option A below gives you a longer contract term to plan with.

On the alloy surcharge:
The alloy surcharge for stainless grade 316L changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

On bar prices:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On our own purchase history with you:
Our orders of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled with you were placed at EUR 5.45 on 2024-10-07 (po:4500011523-10), EUR 5.33 on 2025-06-05 (po:4500012560-10), EUR 5.24 on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013482-10) and EUR 5.45 on 2026-09-24 (po:4500014455-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.96; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.95; no index clause; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: with the cost lines moving down and our price history flat, it gives Edelstahl-Service Donautal a longer contract term at a clear unit price. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you are not the final decision-maker, could you please take Option A to the person who decides? Option A is a clear package: a longer contract and a simple price with no index clause to administer. It is easy to approve as it stands, and we can provide anything the approval needs.

Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change data you cited, that is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. While we acknowledge the index movements you cited, our material is covered at fixed prices for the foreseeable future, limiting the impact of recent market fluctuations. 

We cannot offer a fixed price for a 24-month term, so we have included an AS-14404 index clause to accommodate your request for a longer contract. We are unable to share proprietary internal calculations, but we have revised our offer to EUR 5.35 based on your 45-day payment option. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our Angebot stands at a price of €5.23 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, a price of €5.35 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.35 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
messages.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

You said you cannot offer a fixed price for a longer term.

We note that you accepted our price history data. We also noted that your alloy is covered at fixed prices, so we will not argue that point again. Our focus is on what we can settle between us.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 88.0% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70710@2026Q3).

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives you the longer contract you asked for, and the delivery record is the reason the unit price in it is where it is.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.02; no index clause; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.99; no index clause; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this may need a pricing decision on your side, please take Option A to the person who approves it. We are glad to provide whatever that approval needs.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Our primary proposal is a price of €5.23 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.32 per unit. Please note that a contract term of 24 months applies to this alternative as well.

We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. For your reference, our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
